title: CONNECT-IP Forwarding and MTU Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP forwarding and MTU policy behavior.
scope: This verification covers received IP packet processing decisions, additional filtering policy, failed-check forwarding-error classification, route matching before HTTP Datagram transmission, Hop Count/TTL decrement on encapsulation and before transmission, decapsulation and self-generated-packet exceptions, link-local forwarding suppression, IPv6 MTU minimums, ICMPv6 echo MTU probing, low-QUIC-MTU stream abort policy, ICMP forwarding-error signaling, invalid-source and unroutable-destination ICMPv6 code selection, Packet Too Big feedback, and proxied ICMP processing when ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT is absent.
preconditions: RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP datagram and route advertisement support is implemented.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP forwarding tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 forwarding artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0168-0185 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 forwarding, Hop Count/TTL, MTU, and ICMP forwarding-error policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
